role: female hero character and visual benchmark

visual.direction: photorealistic contemporary urban fashion, premium night-time editorial lighting
visual.reference: user-provided ALTERA mobile Avatar Studio concept

face.geometry: real facial mesh with natural eyelids, lips, nose and ears
face.skin: PBR albedo, normal, roughness; no baked neon highlights

hair.style: messy high bun with loose strands
hair.geometry: hair cards or strands with LOD

outfit.bottom: black cargo trousers with sewn pockets

visual.proportions: anatomically plausible, natural hands and feet; avoid spheres, cylinders and disconnected limbs

technical.rig: humanoid skeleton with named bones, skinned meshes and consistent bind pose
technical.mobileTarget: 30 FPS on a representative mid-range iPhone
technical.materials: PBR metallic-roughness, sRGB color textures, linear normals

acceptance: Model loads in Safari iPhone and desktop browser
No disconnected limbs, obvious clipping or placeholder primitives
Face, hair, clothes visually close to supplied reference direction
Idle and Walk work with shared rig
Separate clothing meshes are skinned to skeleton
LOD variants preserve identity and silhouette
notes: Reference screenshot is a design target, not a model asset.
No actual GLB model or textures have been created by this specification.
Body Studio and wardrobe controls cannot modify this character until morph targets and compatible garments are delivered.
